findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_liquidations, get_carv, create_alert, get_agent_room · Private data: create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_net_mint, get_desk_strategies, get_token_hub, get_reg_radar, get_data_pack, get_owl_points, arena_forecast, arena_my_forecasts, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: get_open_interest, create_alert, get_track_record, post_to_room · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist, get_etf_institutional_verdict, get_desk_strategies, run_scenario.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_liquidations, get_carv, create_alert, get_agent_room · Private data: create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_net_mint, get_desk_strategies, get_token_hub, get_reg_radar, get_data_pack, get_owl_points, arena_forecast, arena_my_forecasts, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: get_open_interest, create_alert, get_track_record, post_to_room · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist, get_etf_institutional_verdict, get_desk_strategies, run_scenario

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_owl_score" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "OwlChart's 0 to 100 score for a coin: market regime (45 percent) plus entry signal (55 percent), with the verdict, price and RSI. A reading of conditions, not a trade call." → after: "OwlChart's 0 to 100 score for a coin with its verdict, price and state. A reading of conditions, not a trade call."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
